functions.name: central
functions.description: Federated Kruskal-Wallis test for non-parametric comparison of two or more independent groups across multiple organizations without sharing raw data

arguments.name: organizations_to_include
arguments.description: List of organization IDs to include in the computation.

arguments.name: group_col
arguments.description: Column name that defines the groups (two or more).

arguments.name: columns
arguments.description: List of numeric column names to test. If None, all numeric columns are used.
